title: Replication
items: Which three configurations can policy-based replication implement?
High availability, disaster recovery, and HA with DR to a third system
Local snapshots, cloud snapshots, and tape backup
Metro Mirror, Global Mirror, and FlashCopy only
Policy-based Replication 可實作 HA (兩系統 Active-Active)、DR (非同步或同步) 與 HA + DR (再複製到第三系統)。
Which object is used to implement policy-based high availability and disaster recovery?
以 Storage Partition 實作 HA 與 DR；Partition 內含 Volume、Volume Group、Host、Host Cluster 與 Mapping。
簡報 S4；Concept Guide Ch8 High availability
What happens when an HA replication policy is associated with a partition?
All objects in the partition are automatically configured across both systems
Only volumes are copied; hosts must be re-created
Replication starts only after a manual sync command
HA Replication Policy 關聯到 Partition 後，Partition 內所有物件會自動在兩個系統建立。
What happens to SSH host keys when a partition managed through its partition IP address fails over?
They remain consistent so clients do not require manual intervention
They are regenerated on every failover
They change to the system host keys
SSH access is lost until reconfigured
以 Partition IP 管理時，系統提供 Partition 專屬 SSH Host Key，且 HA Failover 時保持一致。
For an existing partition after upgrade, how do you enable partition-specific SSH host keys?
Detach and reattach the management portset for the partition
升級後既有 Partition 可能仍使用系統 SSH Server，需將 Partition 的 Management Portset 解除後再重新連結。
What is the active management system of an HA partition?
The system from which all configuration tasks must be performed
The system with the most capacity
The system that hosts the IP quorum
Active Management System 是所有設定作業必須執行的系統，故障時會自動 Failover 到另一系統。
What is the preferred management system?
The system you want to be active under ideal conditions and preferred to keep the partition accessible if the systems disconnect
The system that stores the quorum disk
The system that runs the GUI
The system with the newer code level
Preferred Management System 是理想情況下希望擔任 Active 的系統，也是兩系統斷線時優先保持 Partition 可存取者。
What is the role of the partnership IP quorum application in policy-based HA?
It arbitrates between systems to determine which operates as the active management system after a failure
Partnership IP Quorum Application 部署在獨立伺服器上，故障時仲裁哪個系統擔任 Active Management System。
Where can partition users in an HA partition be created, modified, and removed?
Only on the active management system
Only on the preferred management system
Only on the IP quorum server
Partition User 只能在 Active Management System 上管理，系統會將 User 與憑證複製到對端。
Concept Guide Ch8 Managing partition users
How many I/O groups can be configured in a system that uses policy-based HA?
Policy-based HA 的限制之一是系統內只能設定 1 個 I/O Group。
簡報 S5；Concept Guide Ch8 Planning high availability
Can one partnership be used for both high availability and disaster recovery replication?
HA 最多使用 1 個 Partnership，且同一 Partnership 不能同時用於 HA 與 DR。
What is required for host clusters in an HA storage partition?
Both systems running IBM Storage Virtualize 9.1.0 or later
At least 4 hosts in the cluster
Host Cluster 要放在 HA Partition 中，兩系統皆需 9.1.0 以上。
From which version are SCSI Persistent Reservations supported for Fibre Channel hosts in HA?
FC Host 的 SCSI Persistent Reservation 需兩系統 8.7.2 以上；iSCSI 需 8.7.3 以上。
Are NVMe reservations supported for NVMe-FC and NVMe-TCP hosts in HA?
NVMe-FC 與 NVMe-TCP Host 不支援 NVMe Reservation。
What is the maximum round-trip time supported for the inter-site link in policy-based HA?
Policy-based HA 系統間站點連線最多支援 1 毫秒 RTT。
Concept Guide Ch8 Planning high availability
Which TCP port must be accessible on the management IP for REST API access between systems?
系統間 REST API 需要 Port 7443；以 GUI 設定時瀏覽器到兩系統也需開放 7443 與 443。
Is Network Address Translation (NAT) between systems supported for policy-based replication?
Which multipath policy must hosts use with policy-based HA?
Host 必須使用符合 ALUA 的 Multipath Policy；相容性需原生 Multipath Driver，第三方方案未經驗證。
How should hosts with non-uniform connectivity (each host connected to only one location) be configured?
Specify a location for each host and group them in a host cluster with uniform connectivity set to No
Map them to a side partition
Use a separate partition for each host
Non-uniform Topology 時為每台 Host 指定 Location，並放入 uniform connectivity 設為 No 的 Host Cluster，且應成對定義。
Which volumes cannot be used with policy-based high availability?
Image mode, cache disabled, or cloud snapshot volumes
Policy-based HA 不能用於 Image Mode、Cache 停用或設定 Cloud Snapshot 的 Volume。
Which operation is NOT allowed on a volume in a storage partition with a replication policy assigned?
Expanding the volume on 9.1.0 or later
Mapping it to a host in the partition
已指派 Replication Policy 的 Partition 內 Volume 不能 Shrink；兩系統 9.1.0 以上時可 Expand。
Which host type must hosts configured for high availability use?
HA Host 必須使用 Generic Host Type，使用已淘汰 Host Type 的既有 Host 需改為 Generic。
Concept Guide Ch8 Requirements and considerations
Which CLI topology value is used to create an HA replication policy?
以 `mkreplicationpolicy -topology 2-site-ha` 建立 HA Replication Policy。
A partition that can be used to construct a storage partition but has no effect until it is published
A partition used for testing DR
A partition that holds only snapshots
A partition created automatically during failover
Draft Partition 用來建構 Storage Partition，在 `chpartition -publish` 發佈前沒有作用；每個系統只允許一個 Draft Partition。
Concept Guide Ch8 Adding high availability
When can a draft partition be published?
Only when all required volumes are in volume groups
Only when it contains no hosts
Draft Partition 只有在所有需要的 Volume 都在 Volume Group 中時才能發佈。
Which command merges a second partition into the first?
Which VMware ESXi 8.0 NVMe transports are supported with policy-based HA?
Concept Guide 說明 ESXi 8.0 在 HA 中只支援 NVMe/TCP 或 NVMe/FC。
For Proxmox VE HA, what should be done to shared LVM volume groups?
Remove the LVM system ID by running vgchange --systemid "" <vgname>
Use one volume group per host
需移除共用 Volume Group 的 LVM System ID，讓 Failover 時可跨 Node 啟用，並以 --shared 1 註冊。
What is a highly available (HA) snapshot?
A volume group snapshot that exists on both systems with the same data and can be restored without suspending HA
A snapshot stored in the cloud
A snapshot that exists on one system only
HA Snapshot 同時存在兩個系統且資料相同，Restore 時不需暫停 HA。
簡報 S7、S8；Concept Guide Ch8 Highly available snapshots
What happens when you restore from a local snapshot in an HA partition?
HA is suspended until resynchronization of the restored data completes
The snapshot is converted to an HA snapshot
Local Snapshot 只存在單一系統，Restore 會暫停 HA，直到 Restore 資料重新同步完成。
Which field indicates whether a snapshot is HA or local in the CLI or REST API?
CLI 或 REST API 以 ha_status 欄位區分 HA 或 Local Snapshot。
What is the effect of enabling or disabling HA snapshots?
It affects new snapshots only; existing snapshots are unchanged
啟用或停用 HA Snapshot 只影響新建的 Snapshot，既有 Snapshot 不變。
If HA is not established when a snapshot is taken on the active management system with HA snapshots enabled, what is created?
HA 已建立時建立 HA Snapshot；HA 未建立時則建立 Local Snapshot。
Concept Guide Ch8 Using HA snapshots
What happens to HA snapshots when HA is removed from a partition?
They are converted to local snapshots
They are moved to the cloud
移除 Partition 的 HA 時，HA Snapshot 會轉為 Local Snapshot。
Where are clones or thin-clones created from an HA snapshot outside the HA partition?
Only on the system where the command is run
Only on the preferred management system
Only on the third DR system
在 HA Partition 外由 HA Snapshot 建立的 Clone 或 Thin-clone，只會建立在執行指令的系統上。
What should be decided first when planning disaster recovery replication?
RPO, application requirements, and inter-site connectivity
規劃 DR 時先決定 RPO、應用需求與站點間連線。
How does a higher round-trip time (RTT) affect DR replication?
The higher the RTT, the lower the maximum throughput
RTT 越高，最大 Throughput 越低；高資料變動率加上低 Bandwidth 難以達成低 RPO。
Replication protects against site disasters. What should be added to protect against data corruption and cyberattacks?
Replication 會把損毀資料一併複製，需另搭配 Safeguarded Snapshot 防範資料損毀與網路攻擊。
With how many other systems can one system have DR partnerships?
依簡報整理，一個系統最多可與 3 個其他系統建立 DR Partnership。
In DR, which volume group mode is the replication source with the most up-to-date data?
Production 模式可供 Host I/O 與設定變更，是 Replication 來源並擁有最新資料。
What access does a volume group in Recovery mode provide when a valid recovery point exists?
Recovery 為 Replication 目標，有有效復原點時可唯讀存取；測試復原或獨立存取時轉為可讀寫。
What happens when access is enabled on the recovery side of a DR volume group?
Both sides enter Independent mode and replication is suspended
在復原端啟用存取後進入 Independent，兩端各自可 I/O，Replication 暫停；重新啟動後復原端會自動追上生產端。
What determines the initial replication direction for a DR policy?
The system on which the policy is associated with the volume group
The system with the lower ID
Policy 本身不定義方向，初始方向由關聯 Volume Group 的系統決定。
What happens if the policy is removed on the production side?
The recovery-side volume group is deleted
The production volume group is deleted
於生產端移除 Replication Policy 會刪除復原端的 Volume Group。
In a 3-site configuration, what does HA provide and what does the third system add?
Zero RPO and zero RTO from HA, plus disaster protection through DR replication to the third system
三站點中 HA 提供零 RPO 與零 RTO，第三個系統透過 DR Replication 提供災難保護。
Which connectivity types can a partnership use?
Partnership 可使用 FC 或 IP 連線，用於移轉、Replication 與 HA。
What happens to certificates when a partnership is created in the GUI?
Certificates are exchanged automatically and a truststore is created
Certificates must always be exchanged manually
Certificates are created on the IP quorum
GUI 建立 Partnership 時自動交換憑證並建立 Truststore；CLI 則需另行交換。
What does a pool link define?
The pool on the remote system in which replicated volumes are created
Pool Link 定義遠端系統建立 Replicated Volume 的 Pool。
What does a portset link define?
The portset used when hosts are created on the remote system
The ports used for replication only
Portset Link 定義在遠端建立 Host 時使用的 Portset；replication_portset_link_uid 相同即為已連結。
How many FC I/O ports can each FC replication portset contain?
Up to 4, with at least 2 recommended
每個 FC Replication Portset 最多 4 個 FC I/O Port，建議至少 2 個。
